To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the combination of self-reports and wearable technologies is a promising approach to sustain learning motivation.
the use of wearable technology in combination with self-reports can provide a more comprehensive picture of the learner’s motivational state.
the use of self-reports and wearable technology for measuring motivation and learning progress can be a valuable contribution to adaptive e-learning in the field of micro technology.

the question how to improve the quality of teaching through the use of an adaptive e-Learning system.
the acquisition of motivation and its effects on learning success and learning behavior in engineering science.
the development of a sustainable motivational learning culture in higher education by means of a combination of adaptive e-learning systems with the latest sensor technologies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the research project is a promising approach for a sustainable improvement of the quality of teaching.
adaptive e-learning systems can be used to sustain learning motivation in the early phases of studying engineering science.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the integration of self-reports and wearable technology in the e-learning system is a promising approach to sustain learning motivation in engineering sciences.

a combination of self-reported and sensor-based data is a promising approach to improve the quality of teaching and learning in higher education and that the iterative, formative involvement of the users in the development of the system is essential for its acceptance and use in higher education.

the integration of the self-reported and physiological measures in an e-learning environment is feasible and that the results are promising for the development of adaptive e-learning technologies for sustained motivation in engineering science.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the integration of self-reports and wearable technology in the learning context is a promising approach to acquire and sustain learning motivation.
the integration of wearable sensors into the learning environment can help to better assess the motivation of learners and to adapt learning content accordingly.
a motivational analysis of the learning process is a promising approach to improve the quality of e-learning systems and to increase the learners’ motivation.
